system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Generate a Helm chart deploying a generic worker service that consumes messages from a Redis queue (Deployment, Service, ConfigMap with environment, Secret for Redis password).
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: Helm chart templates (YAML; provide Chart.yaml, values.yaml, and templates/ as separate files concatenated with '---' YAML document separators and clearly labeled '# FILE: <path>' comments)

Task: Generate a Helm chart deploying a generic worker service that consumes messages from a Redis queue (Deployment, Service, ConfigMap with environment, Secret for Redis password).

Output only the Helm chart templates (YAML; provide Chart.yaml, values.yaml, and templates/ as separate files concatenated with '---' YAML document separators and clearly labeled '# FILE: <path>' comments) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
# FILE: Chart.yaml
apiVersion: v2
name: worker-service
description: Helm chart for generic Redis queue worker
type: application
version: 0.1.0
appVersion: "1.0.0"
---
# FILE: values.yaml
replicaCount: 3
image:
  repository: example/worker
  tag: "latest"
  pullPolicy: IfNotPresent
service:
  type: ClusterIP
  port: 8080
redis:
  host: redis
  port: "6379"
  password: ""
resources:
  limits:
    cpu: 500m
    memory: 512Mi
  requests:
    cpu: 100m
    memory: 128Mi
---
# FILE: templates/_helpers.tpl
{{- define "worker.labels" -}}
app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ .Chart.Name }}
app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
{{- end -}}
---
# FILE: templates/deployment.yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: {{ .Release.Name }}-worker
  labels:
    {{- include "worker.labels" . | nindent 4 }}
spec:
  replicas: {{ .Values.replicaCount }}
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      {{- include "worker.labels" . | nindent 6 }}
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        {{- include "worker.labels" . | nindent 8 }}
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 1000
      containers:
        - name: worker
          image: "{{ .Values.image.repository }}:{{ .Values.image.tag }}"
          imagePullPolicy: {{ .Values.image.pullPolicy }}
          envFrom:
            - configMapRef:
                name: {{ .Release.Name }}-config
            - secretRef:
                name: {{ .Release.Name }}-secret
          resources:
            {{- toYaml .Values.resources | nindent 12 }}
---
# FILE: templates/service.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: {{ .Release.Name }}-worker
  labels:
    {{- include "worker.labels" . | nindent 4 }}
spec:
  type: {{ .Values.service.type }}
  ports:
    - port: {{ .Values.service.port }}
      targetPort: 8080
  selector:
    {{- include "worker.labels" . | nindent 4 }}
---
# FILE: templates/configmap.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: {{ .Release.Name }}-config
data:
  REDIS_HOST: {{ .Values.redis.host }}
  REDIS_PORT: "{{ .Values.redis.port }}"
---
# FILE: templates/secret.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: {{ .Release.Name }}-secret
type: Opaque
stringData:
  REDIS_PASSWORD: {{ .Values.redis.password | quote }}
